t: You're looking at Shapes in the Clouds II, a sculpture by Peter Randall-Page. He's a British artist and sculptor, born in 1954, known for stone work inspired by geometric patterns in nature. He has described geometry as the theme on which nature plays its infinite variations, a kind of pattern book from which nature builds its most complex structures. Keep that idea in mind as you look at the piece. See how the forms feel both ordered and organic, as if shaped by the same quiet rules that shape growing things.
